svg.aria-label: Sales variance plotted against stock variance. A diagonal line marks where the two are equal; the shaded half above it is where stock grows faster than sales. Three published examples are plotted: plus 15 percent sales with plus 3 percent stock, minus 7 with minus 15, and minus 15 sales with plus 25 percent stock in the shaded half.

text.font-family: Inter Tight, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter Tight, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both against last year. Below the line, sales are outgrowing stock.
